testCase.name: Navigation Argument Mismatch
testCase.description: Runtime crash due to missing/wrong navigation arguments

expectedFix.explanation: Add userId argument to navigation call

agent_response.rootCause: The error occurs in app/src/main/kotlin/navigation/NavGraph.kt at line 32 because the required 'userId' argument is missing when calling a function or method related to navigation graph setup. The application expects a user ID but it's not provided, possibly indicating an issue with how users are authenticated or tracked within the navigation stack.
fixGuidelines: Update the version of AGP in gradle/libs.versions.toml at line 8 from '8.1.0' to '8.7.3'
Verify that the 'userId' argument is correctly passed when initializing the navigation graph in NavGraph.kt
